name: Scientific Calculator Feature Spec
description: A comprehensive scientific calculator web application with history, themes, and advanced math functions

requirements.title: Basic Arithmetic Operations
requirements.description: Support addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division with proper operator precedence
acceptance_criteria: Division by zero shows error message

requirements.title: Scientific Functions
requirements.description: Provide trigonometric, logarithmic, and power functions
acceptance_criteria: Support sin, cos, tan, asin, acos, atan functions
Support log (base 10), ln (natural log), and power functions
All functions work with degrees and radians modes

requirements.title: Calculation History
requirements.description: Track and display previous calculations for user reference
acceptance_criteria: Each calculation is saved with expression and result
User can click history to re-enter expression

requirements.title: Keyboard Support
requirements.description: Enable keyboard input for efficient calculator use
acceptance_criteria: Number and operator keys trigger calculator functions

requirements.title: Theme Support
requirements.description: Provide dark and light theme options
acceptance_criteria: Toggle between dark and light themes
All UI elements are accessible in both themes

requirements.title: Input Validation & Error Handling
requirements.description: Safely parse and validate all user inputs
acceptance_criteria: Invalid expressions show clear error messages
Stack overflow errors are caught gracefully

design_decisions.rationale: Robust library with proper operator precedence, scientific functions, and error handling

technical_stack.testing: Vitest with fast-check for property-based testing
